CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT building_name AS building_with_max_students_proxy,
       assignable_area AS proxy_assignable_sqft
FROM housing_buildings
ORDER BY assignable_area DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE housing_buildings AS
SELECT 
  building_number,
  building_name_long AS building_name,
  building_use,
  assignable_area
FROM beaver.fclt_building
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  building_number,
  building_name_long AS building_name,
  building_use,
  assignable_area
FROM beaver.fac_building
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  building_number,
  building_name AS building_name,
  NULL::VARCHAR AS building_use,
  bldg_assignable_square_footage AS assignable_area
FROM beaver.buildings

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT * FROM housing_buildings
  WHERE (building_use ILIKE '%residence%'
      OR building_use ILIKE '%dorm%'
      OR building_use ILIKE '%housing%'
      OR building_use ILIKE '%residential%'
      OR building_use ILIKE '%fraternity%'
      OR building_use ILIKE '%sorority%'
      OR building_name ILIKE '%residence%'
      OR building_name ILIKE '%dorm%'
      OR building_name ILIKE '%house%'
      OR building_name ILIKE '%hall%'
      OR building_name ILIKE '%fraternity%'
      OR building_name ILIKE '%sorority%')
), ranked AS (
  SELECT building_name AS building_with_max_students_proxy,
         assignable_area AS proxy_assignable_sqft
  FROM candidates
  WHERE assignable_area IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY assignable_area DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
), fallback AS (
  SELECT building_name AS building_with_max_students_proxy,
         assignable_area AS proxy_assignable_sqft
  FROM housing_buildings
  WHERE assignable_area IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY assignable_area DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM ranked
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM fallback
LIMIT 1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 
  building_with_max_students_proxy AS building_name,
  proxy_assignable_sqft,
  CEIL(proxy_assignable_sqft / 200.0) :: BIGINT AS estimated_students
FROM conductor_s_execution

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
SELECT 
  building_name,
  estimated_students AS students_accommodated,
  'Estimated via assignable sqft proxy (1 bed per 200 sqft)' AS methodology
FROM conductor_s_execution
